text_block_list.text:
<chrname> made a successful debut! After wrapping 
up the meeting about her next goal, I 
leave the waiting room with a deep sense 
of fulfillment—
choice_data_list:
(That said, I can't just be happy about 
it)

text_block_list.text:
The crowd felt sparse again today, and 
even the Winning Live for the main race 
seemed somewhat lacking in excitement.
choice_data_list:
(If only I can convey the charm of 
racing...)

text_block_list.text:
"Even so, <chrname> is in the Junior Class. This is 
a preparatory period to develop her body 
and gain experience for next year's 
Classic Class."

When it comes to conveying how interesting 
racing is, there is little that can be 
done right now.
choice_data_list:
(If so, what we should do right now is 
rather—)

text_block_list.text:
Polishing an Umamusume's inherent charm... 
Bringing out the charm of <chrname> in order to win 
support from fansâ

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah~~!!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: —Make the turn and...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Strike a pose♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"...If you arrange it like this, it'll 
really stand out on stage!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see...! You certainly had my eyes glued 
to you just now.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Super Ultra Fierce Idol 
Cyborg, Haiseiko-san!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: T-That's really going too far!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
By the way, since you gave me guidance... 
may I call myself Haiseiko's direct 
apprentice? I think it'd be great 
publicity!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haiseiko-chaaan, please make me your 
disciple too~~~!

That was only natural. Haiseiko was an 
active super idol, beloved by people of 
all ages...

Every song released was a commercial 
tie-in, magazines featuring her on the 
cover sold out instantly... and recently, 
her dome tour wrapped up in massive 
success.

With such a massive superstar right here 
on campus, it's no wonder the students are 
buzzing with excitement.
choice_data_list:
(Come to think of it, she might be the 
only unusual one here...?)

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—If one always keeps fair play in mind, 
even unintentional infractions can be 
avoided.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Because in moments that demand 
split-second decisions, it eliminates a 
step in your thought process. In other 
words, what I recommend is...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I see...! That's very educational!

Speed Symboli, who belongs to the URA, 
combines her own experience with sound 
knowledge to give clear, insightful advice 
to the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
—Therefore, there is only one path. Please 
consult your own Trainer.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Differences in thinking should be resolved 
early. If left to fester, things can never 
go back to the way they were.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Do not fret. As long as we act now, we 
will surely find a breakthrough.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Lady St. Lite...! Thank you very much...!

Though once an enigmatic presence, St Lite 
continues to guide lost Umamusume with her 
remarkably elevated perspective and 
profound insight.

Amidst all this, Haiseiko taught the 
Umamusume how to sing, dance, and handle 
media appearances, while—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haiseiko-chan! Look over here~~!!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, I struck a pose!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~, so cuuuute~~!!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
I am supposed to be the older sister 
figure here, aren't I...?

Perhaps partly due to her approachable 
character, even now, months later, she 
continues to captivate the Umamusume.
choice_data_list:
(Looking at them again, they're all big 
names, but...)

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! I'm so sorry! I really have to get 
going soon!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
I'm having a solo concert soon! Please 
come by if you'd like, everyone!♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah~~!! Haiseiko-chaaaan!!

—The idol, Haiseiko. Why is she so 
beloved? If only I could uncover that 
secret...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: My... attendant?
choice_data_list: Yes! Please, let me do it!

text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd become Haiseiko's attendant 
until the concert and follow her closely 
to discover what makes her so charming.

A simple behind-the-scenes coverage might 
suffice. However, to truly understand the 
essence, I believed I needed to become an 
active participant myself.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
...I understand how you feel! However, I'm 
still a little worried...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Things might get reaaally hectic. One of 
our managers even quit just recently...
choice_data_list:
In that case, you'll need an extra pair of 
hands, right?!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...That's true. I think the other 
managers would be happy too.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"...Watching <nickname>'s training, while my 
attendant..."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
I think it will be reaaally tough. Are you 
truly okay with this?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Really, really?
choice_data_list:
I won't be any trouble, please let me do 
it!!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: *staaare...*

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood! Then by all means, please 
do!♪"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Besides, you seem really serious 
about it, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"I have full confidence in my eye for 
people♪ I look forward to working with 
you!"

And so, it was decided that for the next 
few months until Haiseiko's live 
performance... I would act as her personal 
attendant!
